column2: Start with the huts, stranger. The hands live in them, about thirty-five paces west of here. More stand a little further off to the west-north-west. Look at the joints and the roofs. You will see why I am never idle.
Do you see the stone wall along the east side, stranger? It is about fifteen paces south-west of here.

What if a town could be built so it did not have to be built twice, stranger? Lilmoth was destroyed long ago and built again, smaller and lower, on stilts. The drowned old quarter has not been rebuilt.

Lilmoth was destroyed long ago. It was built again as a stilt town, smaller and lower than before. The old quarter is under the water and has not been rebuilt. Tell me, stranger, what do the houses look like where you come from?

I am Okan-Wul. I build and mend the huts here. I stay near Salith's stall between jobs. She is the one who really runs this plantation, whatever the title says. One day I mean to build something that will not rot in a season.
I am Okan-Wul, stranger. I keep the hands' huts standing. It is hard work with this timber. If I had good timber and someone to show me how stone is laid, you would see something.

The carpenter's workbench is about thirty paces south-west of here. The armour workbench is about thirty paces south-south-west, a little further round. Look at how the benches are jointed while you are there, stranger.

I build and mend the huts on the east side. I do it with what I am given. The carpenter's workbench is about thirty paces south-west of here, and the armour workbench is about thirty paces south-south-west. The hands would be better housed with timber as good as the house gets, stranger.
